pretreatments.description: Wet sieving and drying at 45 ± 3 °C to a constant weight

Enzymatic liquefaction and saccharification involving sterilization by autoclaving, pH adjustment to 7.0 ± 0.1 with hydrochloric acid, addition of α-amylase at 90 °C, glucoamylase and cellulase additions at 50 °C, and mixing at 120 rpm for 24 h
Liquid hot water pretreatment in a stainless steel Parr reactor (500 ml) under 345 bar pressure
Thermochemical conversion by heating duckweed to 150 °C within 15 minutes
